ideas.title: Investigation into Minneapolis Shooting
ideas.description: This story would investigate the shooting of Alex Pretti by Border Patrol agents, including the circumstances surrounding the incident and the subsequent investigation.
ideas.angle: Examining the use of force by federal agents and potential patterns of concern
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
What is the status of the investigation?
ideas.insight: The incident has sparked widespread outrage and calls for investigation, indicating a potential pattern of concern with federal law enforcement tactics.

ideas.title: Federal Agency Accountability
ideas.description: This story would examine the accountability of federal agencies, including Border Patrol and Department of Homeland Security, in light of the Minneapolis shooting.
ideas.angle: Investigating patterns of concern with federal law enforcement tactics
questions: What patterns of concern have been identified?
What steps are being taken to address these concerns?
ideas.insight: The incident has raised concerns about the tactics used by federal agents and the need for accountability, indicating a potential pattern of concern with federal law enforcement tactics.
